title: IdealCurve v1
description: A relative, level-invariant target EQ shape. Mirrors IdealProfile in packages/audio-engine/src/profiles/index.ts so Mac-exported profiles decode on iOS unchanged. freqs and dbOffsets must be the same length and freqs strictly ascending; JSON Schema cannot express either rule, so apps/ios/scripts/validate_contracts.py and the Swift decoder enforce them.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. Bump (and add a new schema file) on any breaking change.

freqs.description: Grid-point center frequencies in Hz (the Mac grid is 48 log-spaced points, 20 Hz-20 kHz).

dbOffsets.description: Relative target shape in dB at each freqs point. Shape only, never absolute level.
